capabilities.justification: The fuzz engine (VER06o) runs every target execution in its own forked thread with a per-thread allocation limit and kills it on a wall-clock timeout; one thread per execution (a thread stuck in an uninterruptible foreign call is leaked, never waited for). The PBT budget helpers fork children on request.
The execution thread reports its outcome to the engine through one MVar, and the engine waits on it with a bounded timeout.
Every target execution is bounded by System.Timeout's wall-clock timer (the RTS monotonic timer); no calendar time is read.

justification: No filesystem, network, calendar clock or environment access. The library forks one thread per fuzz target execution; the tests read the committed pbt-v1 and fuzz-v1 fixtures and Go's fuzz reference-vector table.
